text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the spring Classics. Intense
training is
off the table for now, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby. Unable to resist
this
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, we
shoot for the
stars. And the result?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...You were wise not to push for victory.
That
said, I do think we could have
skipped this race
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll need you to go as hard with
your
treatment as she went on herself.
We'll be
administering supplements 3a,
8b, and 6d_2 in
that order.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll be needing three days' rest. But
given that
we've eased up on your
training, I'm sure you'll be
fine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's a little late for apologies,
don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We all chase after that which we know
to be
unattainable. People,
Umamusume, all of us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After providing her with the best
possible
aftercare, Manhattan Cafe pulls
through without
any serious issues and
we hold out hope for the
autumn season.
